audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's reply: longing to find God's seat, legal confidence, hiddenness in every direction, holding the divine path, and trembling before Shaddai's decree.

verses.restored: Even today my complaint is rebellion; my hand is heavy because of my groaning.

familiar.text: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

verses.restored: If only I knew where I could find him, that I might come to his seat!

familiar.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

verses.restored: I would arrange my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.

familiar.text: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.restored: I would know the words he would answer me and understand what he would say to me.

familiar.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

verses.restored: Would he contend with me in great power? No; he himself would pay attention to me.

familiar.text: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

verses.restored: There an upright person could argue with him, and I would be delivered forever from my judge.

familiar.text: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

verses.restored: Look, I go east, but he is not there; west, but I do not perceive him;

familiar.text: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

verses.restored: north, where he works, but I do not behold him; south, but I do not see him.

familiar.text: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

verses.restored: But he knows the way with me; when he has tested me, I shall come out like gold.

familiar.text: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

verses.restored: My foot has held fast to his steps; I have kept his way and not turned aside.

familiar.text: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

verses.restored: From the commandment of his lips I have not departed; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my portion.

familiar.text: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.restored: But he is one, and who can turn him? What his soul desires, he does.

familiar.text: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

verses.restored: For he completes what is appointed for me, and many such things are with him.

familiar.text: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

verses.restored: Therefore I am terrified before his face; I consider, and I dread him.

familiar.text: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.restored: The Divine has made my heart soft, and Shaddai has terrified me.

familiar.text: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

verses.restored: Yet I am not cut off before darkness, nor has he covered deep gloom from my face.

familiar.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
